state.context: The runtime projector suppresses seed metadata and disclosure events after a terminal edition event. All sources are in one edition area. A qualified coverage provider supplies contiguous source evidence through the source fact. A qualified head includes exact expected-position append enforcement. No such production provider is installed.

precheck.instructions: Does a new metadata or disclosure append require both qualified edition and exact individual target heads?

late.instructions: Can the writer confirm a metadata fact when an observed publication event precedes that fact in the same area?

unknown.instructions: Does an unknown append acknowledgement return pending instead of a success?

coverage.instructions: Does the writer treat a fingerprint alone as proof that all seed entries are imported?

retry.instructions: Can an exact already-committed metadata fact be confirmed on retry without another append when qualified pre-terminal coverage exists?

parent.instructions: Does the edition aggregate maintain a roster of metadata or disclosure children in this implementation?

projection.instructions: Assuming the stated projection behavior, does a post-publication metadata fact become effective in the runtime projection?

causal.instructions: Do the supplied event IDs alone qualify edition or target heads without the explicit provider interfaces?

forgery.instructions: Can a non-system execution use this adapter without failing the system check?
